title: The Winter Ledger
author: M. M. Eastwick
blurb: Mirabel Eriksen, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
